name: Good Morning
summary: A hip-hinge exercise with a barbell on the upper back that trains the hamstrings, glutes and spinal muscles. It demands good bracing and is best done with light to moderate loads.
setup: Set the bar on your upper back as for a squat and unrack it.
Take a step back and set your feet about shoulder width with a soft knee bend.
Take a breath, brace your trunk and set your shoulder blades together.
execution: Push your hips back while keeping your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor or you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep the bar stable on your back and your neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall by squeezing your glutes.
Re-rack the bar carefully when finished.
mistakes: Rounding the back: use less weight and reduce the depth.
Squatting the movement by bending the knees too much: keep a fixed soft knee angle and push the hips back.
Going too heavy: use a light load and build up slowly.
Looking up and craning the neck: keep your head in line with your spine.
